title: Prove the sharp 57-ascent bound for the Q96 E8 singleton-gauge chain family
body:
Proves a sharp price of 57 for the fixed E8 basis with one singleton-output gauge, every Q96 port, arbitrary real coefficients and nonzero rescalings, and either order of the shared lifetime. The rational nine-epoch, eight-lifetime replay achieves R=57 with exact output and intake ranks 9 and 8.

Pins #7852 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212 and #7869 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956. python3 -B verify.py --census passed the proof checks, 521,412 unit-gauge support cases and the genuine #7869 engine replay. A signed-tail misuse breaks 22 odd cells. Q5 distinguishes chain cost 2 from decoder mass 3. Source credit retained, OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Other bases, multiple lifetimes and the general Q96 rank-nine chain wall remain open.
